acceptance: Deterministic local stubs answer the exact 0.84.0 Pi version probe.
A failed attempt followed by one fresh retry is reconstructed with distinct job, trace, and local session identifiers.
Bounded registry and trace evidence reports parent-child relationships, attempts, outcomes, unavailable fields, and retry grouping without private content or paths.
One live provider-backed smoke test is separately gated by AS_IS_LIVE_INTEGRATION=1 and explicit PI_BIN with bounded registry, trace, and session assertions; a skip is not a pass.
No product component is modified and task-record evidence remains authoritative over runtime results.
